provenance: Generator-shaped contract inputs: a register fixed to a bv value V reads Z_to_bv (bv_unsigned V) as V (resource_seed.source_z_expression); a tail jump is a function exit, not a call (forward_design); a new RAM guard that the source intervals already imply is not carried (symbolic_state._drop_source_implied_ram_guards).
statement: Source evaluation does not establish any generated contract or predecessor entailment.
limitations: A jump at a CFG return site leaves the function as a function_return exit; any other unknown target stops the path.

An address that carries an owned array base and a symbolic addend reads that array as a list lookup; its index range (below the actual array length) is a path condition and an open read obligation; an array without a length term stops the read. A store at a symbolic index has an owner only when one initialized owned array base is its addend and every other memory resource is disjoint from that array; its index range is an open obligation.
A call ends its block; its return site is a cut that continues only from a call-return seed (call_boundary.call_return_seed). Loop cuts require source-bound inputs.
